English: Festival Green
An open grassy commons ringed with vendor stalls, where townsfolk gather for seasonal fairs and civic announcements.
Village Stage
A simple raised earthen platform for local gatherings and performances, marking the beginnings of organized celebration.
Dancers' Platform
An improved timber platform, attracting traveling performers and lively village dances, nurturing civic culture.
Floats Yard
A secure enclosure for constructing and storing elaborate festival floats, spurring local crafts and urban pride.
Musicians' Pavilion
A sturdy timber hall at the heart of the festival grounds, drawing minstrels and fostering local traditions.
Celebration Court
A stone-paved plaza with ornate canopies, serving as the administrative and cultural heart for civic festivities and decrees.
Procession Lane
A broad, cobbled avenue lined with banners and statues, designed for grand parades and civic processions, boosting trade and prestige.
Market Ring
A ring of permanent shops, guild stalls, and counting houses encircling the festival grounds, drawing merchants from afar.
Feasting Pavilion
A grand covered hall with kitchens and storerooms for hosting banquets, attracting nobles and inspiring trade and prosperity.
Grand Festival Grounds
A sprawling urban complex of plazas, amphitheatres, colonnades, and markets, renowned throughout the realm as the jewel of civic celebration and commerce.
